text: Forvse Nerethi is a Dunmer Agent who can be found in Curio Manor in Vivec City. She is a House Cousin of House Hlaalu.
Freida Oaken-Wand was a Nord warrior sometime in late Merethic Era or early First Era. She fought during the last battle between Nords and Snow Elven.

Frea is a Skaal shaman living in the Skaal Village on Solstheim. She is the daughter of Storn Crag-Strider, and is working to free her people from the influence of Miraak. Frea becomes eligible as a follower or Blade recruit upon completion of the quest "At the Summit of Apocrypha."

Friar Lylim was an Altmeri Trebbite Monk who led an army against Queen Morgiah of Firsthold during the Third Era. As a Trebbite Monk, he valued tradition above every other virtue. Lylim would later flee from battle after his revolt failed.
Fraki is a Nord Pilgrim residing at the Holamayan Monastery. He is a member of the Dissident Priests.
Forven Berano is a Dunmer noble found in the Temple Courtyard in Mournhold. He is a member of House Hlaalu.

Freydis was High Queen of Eastern Skyrim during the Second Era. She was said to have ruled over Windhelm. She was the daughter of High King Logrolf, however, Jarl Svartr of Solitude claimed she was an illegitimate child and thus that she had no claim to the throne. Having ownership over the Crown of Verity, Freydis was named High Queen in the city of Windhelm, and her successors would rule there for years to come.
Fredevieve Jeanne is a Breton tailor and proprietor of A Cut Above in Elden Root, Grahtwood.
Fradion is a Bosmer innkeeper at the Outside Inn in the city of Elden Root, Grahtwood.
Frederic Helomaine is a Breton, residing in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He is found near the Red Rook Camp where Patroller Versien is found.
Franal is a Redguard residing in the Alik'r Camp in Alcaire Castle. He's found just outside of the camp.

Franara Themond is a Breton residing in Stormhaven. She wants to live out in the country and has left Koeglin Village with her husband and an Orsimer named Mungro gro-Gurba. She is the author of Franara's Journal.
Foucault Geric is a Breton member of the Mages Guild found in the hall of Haven. He is the magister of their hall in the city.
Four-Toes is a Khajiit grocer. He sells his wares at his stall at the Wayshrine Court in Dune.
Frederique Gimbert is a Breton and is the keeper of the Westwind Lighthouse and the wife of Parquier Gimbert.
Frederuno Notte is a Breton noble attending to Count Hosni at-Tura's party at his estate.
Frenidela is a Bosmer guild trader selling her wares at the South Shornhelm Stalls in Shornhelm. She has no unique dialogue.
Frerbild is a Nord merchant. She sells her wares at her stall, Frerbild's General Store, at the markets in Nimalten.
Fridda is a Nord survivor of the attack by the Worm Cult on Treva's Farm, in The Rift.

Fredevieve Hastien is a Breton magister found in the Orsinium Mages Guild in the city of Orsinium. She is a member of the Mages Guild. Speaking with Fredevieve will uncover that she, just like other members, is unsatisfied with the facilities provided by the King Kurog.
Franck Lothaire is a Breton patron of the Dusklight Inn in Hoarfrost Downs.
Freigritte is a Nord commoner found inside a house in Iliath Temple. She has no unique dialogue.

Frail Husk is a zombie that appears in . It is located in Quarantine Serk Catacombs, and does not drop any items, or grant any experience for killing. These creatures are neutral, and will only attack if themselves attacked.
Freed Soul is a wraith found near the Soulshriven Tower in . He was enslaved by the necromancers to serve as eyes of Molag Bal, and his soul was bound to a skull.
Freiwen is a Nord in residing near Morthal in Western Skyrim. She is the daughter of Jarl Reddharn and Lady Ninetha.
Fortis Duronius is an Imperial bard in who resides at the Governor's Mansion in Gideon.
Fothxura is a Dremora found as a random encounter in . He can be seen leaving and entering an Oblivion gate created by his Banekin minion Qukikh.
Francois Marquardt was a Breton smuggler found in the Isinfier Plains.
Fryfnhild is a Nord trader at The End of the World in Dagon Fel, Morrowind. She deals in a wide variety of goods.
Gaelion is a Dunmer enforcer living in Tel Branora, Morrowind. He is a member of House Telvanni.
Gadeneri Ralvel is a lost Dunmer ghost found on the Hill of Suicides at the center of the Shivering Isles.
Frostien Ephine is a Breton living in Ebonheart. He is also a member of the Imperial Legion.
Frik is a Nord apothecary and member of the Imperial Cult living in Ebonheart.

Furius Acilius is an Imperial in who lives in Ebonheart. He is a deserter from the Imperial Legion who made off with the Lord's Mail by way of a secret tunnel into Castle Ebonheart. He is immediately hostile to the Nerevarine.
Frinnius Posuceius is an Imperial herder living in the Dren Plantation. He is a member of House Hlaalu.
Fruscia Abitius is an Imperial noble who resides in Ules Manor in the Ascadian Isles region. She is a member of House Hlaalu.

Gabriella is a Dunmer assassin and a member of the Dark Brotherhood. She is a good friend of Olava the Feeble. She and Festus Krex are the only members of the Dark Brotherhood who wear the shrouded outfit.
Frofnir Trollsbane was a troll hunter and possible bandit who met his demise at the hands of trolls.
From-Deepest-Fathoms is an Argonian found at the Riften docks. Involved in the "Unfathomable Depths" quest, she gives the Lexicon that is brought to Avanchnzel.
Fridrika is a Nord farmer who works at Katla's Farm just outside of Solitude.
Frorkmar Banner-Torn is a Nord warrior, soldier and Stormcloak General in who is stationed in The Pale.
Frothar is a Nord child and the eldest son of Balgruuf the Greater, and, as such, is in line to become Jarl of Whiterun.

Gadnor was a Bosmer citizen, whose corpse lies inside Crystaldrift Cave. He, apparently, died peacefully on the cavern's central stone pillar. The exact reasons of his death are unknown, but there are no signs of being attacked by the animals in the cave. Gadnor is holding his staff in his left hand.

Fultheim the Fearless is one of three hostages during the quest "With Friends Like These...." He is a mercenary who was captured from a battlefield. He does not have any ill thoughts against anyone but many people would put contracts on him due to his occupation that involves killing many people; the relatives of the victims may have a grudge against him.

Fruki is a Nord miner in who works in the Quicksilver Mine in Dawnstar. She lives in her house, adjacent to the mine. Like most of the townspeople, she is plagued by terrible nightmares from Vaermina.
Froa was an Atmoran warrior. She was one of the Five Hundred Companions.
Gadasu Serothan is a Dunmer assassin residing in Ashinabi. She and Jine are found together in the smuggler den which is located near the end of the cave system.

Gadela Andus is a Dunmer resident of Morrowind. She can be found in the Elven Nations Cornerclub in Vivec, Hlaalu Canton. Gadela is the proprietor of the cornerclub. She buys and sells potions and alchemical supplies.

Gable the Traitor is a Wraith encountered aboard the Emma May. He was the leader of the mutiny resulting in the death of the Forlorn Watchman. He holds the key to the shackles that hold the skeleton of Grantham Blakeley. He can be taken out with enchanted arrows, an enchanted bow, or silver weapons.

Fura Bloodmouth is a Nord vampire and a member of Lord Harkon's court. She also serves as a master trainer in Two-Handed weapons, provided the Dragonborn joins Harkon's Court. She is usually found near the smithing area of Castle Volkihar, training with a leveled weapon on propped dummies.
Gaenor is a mad, gold-obsessed Bosmer warrior in who resides at the Temple Courtyard and will ask the Nerevarine for large amounts of .
Fryssa was a Nord sorceress. Her corpse can be found inside Benkongerike. She made the robe Whitewalker, which can be found on her corpse, along with her journal.

Furl-Of-Fresh-Leaves is an Argonian highwayman who hailed from the province of Black Marsh. He lived during the Third Era and was an accomplished illusionist. He patrolled the roads the Black Marsh with his partner-in-crime, Drawing-Flame. They attempted to rob and kill Decumus Scotti, but were interrupted by Archein Right-Foot-Rock, an Argonian trader and plantation owner.
Gaeldol is a Bosmer found in Ebonheart. He is a member of the Fighters Guild.

Fura Morrard was the daughter of Angeline Morrard, who is the owner of Angeline's Aromatics in Solitude. She joined the Imperial Legion and was tasked by Legate Quentin Cipius to scout the Stormcloak army.
Gaban is a Breton rogue and bandit, who resides in the Telvayn Ancestral Tomb. He will be hositle towards the Nerevarine on sight.
Frink Ruuz is a Redguard smuggler who resides in the Dwemer ruin of Arkngthand.
Gadodar is a Nord residing in Port Hunding on the island of Stros M'Kai. He has been locked up in a cage by the docks and is begging to be let free.
Gabin Geric is a Breton magister for the local Mages Guild, residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Gadsi Terano is a Dunmer member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Elden Root.
Fugues Cornillac is a Breton who resides in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He can be found listening to one of the guards holding a speech, halfway down to Daggerfall Docks.
Frizkav Brutya is a Breton thief and member of the Thieves Guild who resides in the Ministry of Truth.
Furon Rii is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is part of the team of mages investigating the presence of Chimer spirits in the Starved Plain.
Friends-with-Moon is an Argonian residing at the Tribunal Temple in the city of Mournhold.
Gabrien Zylippe is a Breton member of the Mages Guild residing in the city of Hallin's Stand. He is the magister of their hall in the city.
Fyrayn Romothren is a Dunmer drunkenly parading around Ebonheart's city wall, behind the The Ebony Flask.
Gaboryan Armene is a Breton residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven.
Frikkhild Coldheart is a Nord blacksmith. She works and sells her wares at The Anvil & Pauldron in Windhelm. She is also the author of Crafting Motif 37: Ebony Style.
Gaelion Adlaron is a Dunmer part of the group found inside the outlaws refuge underneath Windhelm.
Gabbi Forestborne is a Nord found at The Tree's Bounty in Windhelm. She is the sister of Agnedir and Alvor Forestborne, as well as the cousin of Jakild Wood-Hewer and Selgaard Wood-Hewer.
Frirhild Frostmoon was a Nord living at her family's farmstead just outside of Riften. Like most of the other family members, she was murdered by an unknown assailant.
Frontarius Ambustus is an Imperial envoy of the Imperial Legion found in the Elden Root. He encourages the people to support the Aldmeri Dominion in the Alliance War.
Furious Jawna is a Redguard member of the Fighters Guild found at the Martyr's Crossing.
Fyrona Hloril is a Dunmer beggar found in Ebonheart. She has no unique dialogue.
Gabbidi is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact found at the Southern Morrowind Gate where she is found sparring with her companion Shimmer-Scales.
Gabria is a Breton member of the Ring of Daggers tracking down Gerard Althen, a war criminal who worked for King Ranser.
Gadof is a Nord member of the Stormfist Clan found in Old Sord's Cave.
Gadris is a Dunmer found in the Vile Laboratory. He can be found up a ramp and on a platform near the entrance of the Laboratory.
Fyrayn Telvanni is a powerful Dunmer ghost of House Telvanni found in the Forgotten Crypts.
Gabria Marck is a Breton found inside the outlaws refuge beneath Orsinium.

Furil Faryon is a Dunmer male residing in the town of Quarantine Serk, in Deshaan, Morrowind. He can be overheard conversing with Earila Faryon, who travelled with him seeking to help him find a cure for the Llodos Plague.
Frostdrool is a Troll that appears in . Frostdrool, along with Sleetclaw, is a troll in Troll Cave that needs to be defeated in order to earn the "Troll Killer" achievement.
Frorkand is a Nord member of the Ebonheart Pact stationed in Fort Virak, Stonefalls.
Frostedge Bulwarks are generic members of the Frostedge Pillagers residing in Frostedge Camp, Bleakrock Isle. They are hostile to the Vestige unless they wear a Frostedge Bandit Disguise.

Frostedge Sentry is a generic member of the Frostedge Pillagers residing in Frostedge Camp and Hozzin's Folly, Bleakrock Isle. They can spot the Vestige through their disguise, causing other Frostedge Pillagers to attack.
Fridrethe is a Nord noble in who resides in Bleakrock Village on Bleakrock Isle.

Fyrulde is a Nord beggar found at the Loose Tooth Lodge in the Stonetooth Fortress. She insists that "nobody cares at all" about her, is concerned about what is to become of her, and suggests that death is beginning to look good to her. However, she has no unique dialogue.
Frunda Wealth-Hoarder is a Nord working as an administrator at the Anvil Repository in Anvil, Gold Coast.
Fronjolf is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. He is part of the team being held captive at the Tower of Lies in Coldharbour.
Friga Bearfist is a Nord prisoner of Marshal Hlaren. She was arrested for assault, which she admits to doing and does not regret, but her punishment was much more severe than the crime she committed.
Gadayn Curio is a Breton drunkard residing in the Saint Olms Waistworks within the Canton of St. Olms the Just in Vivec City. He has no unique dialogue.
Fruth was a hunter assigned to help Attrebus and Sul with their pretended task to research the environment of Solstheim for a new guide to the Empire. He was a red bearded Nord.
Frilan Ruman is a Breton engineer located in Fharun Stronghold's prison. He is available only if the Vosh Rakh have not been attacked during the quest "To Save a Chief."
Frontinus is an Imperial in the Town. He has come to the town to report the death of his brother.
Gabrielle Larouche is an Imperial who can be found in the Town.
Gadeneri Othril is a Dunmer residing in the Tribunal Temple in Ebonheart.
Furykissed Thrall is a generic Nord found at Kynesgrove. While initially hostile, they become neutral after the location's quests are completed.
Furykissed Soldier is a generic Nord found at Kynesgrove, Eastmarch, in . While initially hostile, they become neutral after the location's quests are completed.

Blademaster Gaiden Shinji was the leader of the Order of Diagna who lived some time during the early-to-mid First Era in a point known as the "Classical Period". The Order of Diagna, with the joint forces of Daggerfall and Sentinel, attacked the Orcish kingdom of Orsinium during Gaiden's leadership. The war is known as the Siege of Orsinium. In 1E 948, King Joile of Daggerfall sent a letter to Shinji saying "The orcs have been much plaguing the Wayresters and impeding traffic to the heart of the land." It took thirty years for the joint armies to breach and destroy Orsinium. During his lifetime, he was also the founder and original Blademaster of the Imperial City Arena, which was completed

Ganciele Douar is an Imperial Guard and spearman in the Imperial Legion. He is stationed at the Census and Excise building in Seyda Neen and is there to protect Socucius Ergalla and to make sure that there are no thefts.
Ganus Lloryn is a Dunmer commoner who resides in Ald Velothi. He spends his time outside of his shack, taking long walks or sitting on the docks.
Garyn Girith is a Dunmer Agent and slaver who can be found wandering the outskirts of Ald Velothi in the West Gash.
Garaz is a fictional character, who appears in the following books: *Hallgerd's Tale *Bone, Book I *Bone, Book II *Vernaccus and Bourlor
Galviso Heran is a Dunmer warrior and member of House Redoran who resides in the Dralor Manor within the Vivec, Redoran Canton.
Garothmuk gro-Muzgub is an Orsimer smith who can be found in his store in Suran.

Gaspar Stegine is an advanced Breton spell merchant in Imperial City's Arcane University, in the Praxographical Center. He is available during the daylight hours (8am - 8pm). Unlike other Mages Guild members, Gaspar Stegine wears both a Mage Hood and a Mage Robe.
Galas Drenim is a Dunmer sorcerer residing in Ebonheart in the Grand Council Chambers. She represents House Telvanni in the Grand Council.
Galtus Previa was a farmer who went looking for gems in Nonwyll Cavern. Galtus was killed by savage trolls.
Garding the Bold is a Nord barbarian who resides in the Vivec, St. Olms Canton inside the Haunted Manor. He is the champion of Dram Bero.
Gat Gro-Shargakh is an Orsimer who lives in Kolskeggr Mine, east of Markarth. He becomes a candidate for marriage.
Gallus Desidenius was an Imperial thief and Nightingale who was once the Guildmaster of the Thieves Guild in Riften.

Galmar Stone-Fist is the Nord second-in-command of the Stormcloaks under Ulfric Stormcloak, as well as Ulfric's housecarl. He commands the Stormcloak army when planning assaults on Imperial cities and forts. Galmar sees that all new recruits are properly outfitted with Stormcloak Armor and have taken the Oath.
Garvey is a Breton and Expert-level Sneak trainer. He is the assumed boss/leader of the people living in the Warrens.
Gaius Maro is an Imperial in who is a member of the Penitus Oculatus, the Emperor's personal guard. He is the son of Commander Maro, the guard's leader.

Garthek is a character who is mentioned by Thrynn. Garthek was the leader of a bandit clan comprised of roughly twenty men, including Thrynn, who later joined the Thieves Guild. This clan cared mainly for killing. One day, they came upon a caravan of farmers moving to a new village. Only the women and children remained after the initial attack. Garthek gave an order for the bandits to kill the survivors. Thrynn refused, and Garthek ordered his men to kill him. Thrynn had made some friends within the clan at the time, who quickly sided with him. The ensuing battle destroyed the clan, with the survivors heading their separate ways. Thrynn left Garthek's head on a pike at the wreckage of the ca
Ganna Uriel is an Imperial found in Kynesgrove. She also works and wanders around the Steamscorch Mine. She has a sister named Gemma Uriel.
Galana Septim is the daughter of Emperor Uriel Septim II, and is sister to Pelagius Septim II.
Galos Farethi is a Dunmer warrior, and member of House Hlaalu who can be found at the Dren Plantation.
Galos Mathendis is a Dunmer enchanter in the Telvanni Council House in Sadrith Mora.
Garisa Llethri is a Dunmer noble and Councilor for House Redoran, who resides in Llethri Manor in Ald'ruhn.
Galar Baren is a Dunmer smuggler. He resides in the cave of Nammu, in the region of the Grazelands.
Galasa Uvayn is a Dunmer who resides in the Hlaalu Treasury, in the Hlaalu Canton of Vivec City. She is a member of House Hlaalu.
Galdres Ienith is a Dunmer bandit who resides in the cave of Punammu.
Galero Andaram is a Dunmer who resides in Morrowind. She can be found inside Telvanni Council House in Sadrith Mora. She sells spells and potions.
Galis Seleth is a Dunmer noble who resides in the Vivec, St. Olms Canton.
Galmis Dren is a Dunmer living in Nammu in the Grazelands, along with a group of smugglers.

Galsa Gindu is a Dunmer noble and member of House Redoran who resides in the Redoran Council Hall. She is located inside her house. She can be spoken with in regards to the Nerevarine's stronghold in Bal Isra.
Galtis Guvron is a Dunmer pawnbroker and member of the Thieves Guild who resides in The Rat in the Pot.
Galtis Serethi is a Dunmer battlemage and smuggler who resides in Shurinbaal. He carries the Amulet of Mark.
Galuro Belan is a Dunmer Apothecary and member of House Telvanni. She works and lives in her shop, located in the Telvanni Canton.
Galvene Othrobar is a Dunmer archer who resides in Indarys Manor. She is a member of House Redoran.
Ganalyn Saram is a Dunmer alchemist who is found running his shop in Vivec. He is a member of House Hlaalu.

Gandosa Arobar is a Dunmer noble. She resides in the Arobar Manor in Ald'ruhn and is the daughter of the House Redoran Councilor Miner Arobar. Some intriguing objects most likely belonging to her can be found in a chest in her bedroom: Boethiah's Pillow Book, an indecent work, and also two bottles of Skooma.
Garila Vedas is a Dunmer Scout and Lawman of House Redoran who resides in Indarys Manor. She is also a skill trainer.
Garvs Ramarys is a Dunmer commoner and Retainer for House Redoran who resides in the Ramoran Manor located in the Ald'ruhn, Manor District.
Garyne Uvenim is a Dunmer pilgrim and member of Tribunal Temple, who resides in the Canon Quarters in the Vivec, Temple Canton.
Garer Danoran is a Dunmer agent who resides in the Hlaalu Treasury in the Hlaalu Canton of Vivec City.
Garry is a Redguard commoner who resides in the Maar Gan Shrine in the village of Maar Gan.
Galar Rothan is a Dunmer enchanter who resides in the Telvanni Council House in Sadrith Mora. He can be found at the entry area offering his services to the public.
Galmir is a Bosmer Archer who guards Nartise Arobar while she is being held captive in the Tel Naga Great Hall.
Galthragoth is a Bosmer pauper who resides in his house in Ald'ruhn.
Gancolm is a hostile Redguard healer and smuggler spellcaster who resides in Shurinbaal.
Gamin Girith is a Dunmer commoner and inhabitant of the Raven Rock mining colony on the island of Solstheim.
Garan Marethi is a Dunmer vampire and a member of the Volkihar Clan. He is a senior member of Harkon's Court.
Garmr is a unique death hound found staying with the Volkihar Clan inside Castle Volkihar. Like CuSith, he can become a follower if the Dragonborn has chosen to become a Vampire Lord.

Garnag was an Orsimer assassin for the Dark Brotherhood, residing in the Cheydinhal Sanctuary at the time of the Great War. He hauled the Night Mother's crypt from Bravil after it was raided, and was one of the last surviving members of the Brotherhood in Cyrodiil.

Gallivere Lariat or Lariate was a Breton noble from the Kingdom of Shornhelm that served as the royal consort of Empress Katariah after it was apparent that Pelagius Septim III would pass away. He is the biological father of Uriel Septim IV, who was the first indirect descendant to Tiber Septim.

Garnas Uvalen is a Dunmer commoner and member of the East Empire Company found on the east side of the Raven Rock colony. He is one of three colonists available to become a guard in Raven Rock for the quest "Hiring Guards."

Garyn Ienth is a Dunmer farmer who lives in Raven Rock. He serves as a merchant, dealing mainly in food items which he grows from the ash. He is married to Milore Ienth, who works with him on their farm. He wears a Dunmer outfit and shoes and carries a key to his house. After the eruption of Vvardenfell, he and his wife moved to Morthal. After a few years of living in the town he and his wife heard of the Dunmer colony of Raven Rock. They soon packed their bags and have not looked back since. Since arriving in Raven Rock, he and his wife have opened up Raven Rock's main source of food. His farm is so important as a food source that a Redoran Guard has been posted permanently on his property.

Galdrus Hlervu is a Dunmer priest who can be found at the Raven Rock Temple. He is an apprentice to Elder Othreloth, and is eager to one day take his place. He is one of the more unpleasant and overly judgmental characters to be found in Solstheim.
Galms Seles is a Dunmer commoner who can be found in The Winged Guar in Mournhold's quarter Godsreach, where he plays a game of shells.
Gam-Kur is an Argonian barbarian residing in the cave of Pulk.
Gashna gro-Mogduk is a hostile Orsimer Barbarian residing in the stronghold of Valenvaryon.
Gakkenfeld is an Orsimer warrior who resides on the Gro-Bagrat Plantation.
Garimmir is a Bosmer soldier of the Aldmeri Dominion residing in Eagle's Strand in the region of Khenarthi's Roost.
Garyn Indoril is a Dunmer and the son of Tanval Indoril, the grandmaster of House Indoril. He is heavily involved in the Stonefalls' questline.
Gailen Tramnil is a Breton villager residing in Deleyn's Mill.
Garlub gra-Shugharz is an Orsimer armorer residing in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She can be found at her stall in themarketplace, The Tough Stuff, selling her wares.
Gar is a Nord warrior residing in Hrogar's Hold in Stonefalls. He is the son of Hrogar.
Gannel is a Bosmer who resides in the city of Vulkhel Guard, Auridon.
Gard gro-Wroggin is an Orsimer blacksmith residing in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He can be found selling his wares at his shop, Metalworks of Daggerfall in Tradesman's Square.
Garnikh is an Orsimer residing on the island of Betnikh, Glenumbra. He is found at the Seamount Hunter's Camp, with his sister Sgrugha tending to his wounds.
Garwiril is a Bosmer residing in Woodhearth in the region of Greenshade. She can be found in the upper level of The Improbable Cutlet.
Garmeg the Ironfinder is an Orsimer residing in Lion Guard Redoubt, Glenumbra, in . When the Vestige talks to him he is concerned about the town Crosswych.
Ganise Nurin is a Breton residing on the Nurin Farm with her mother and father in the region of Stormhaven.
Gah Julan is an Argonian slave residing on the Dren Plantation.
Gals Fendyn is a Dunmer guild trader. He operates his kiosk at the Mourner's Market in Mournhold.
Garfrost Halfmoon is a Nord woodworker. She sells her wares at her stall, Halfmoon Arms, in the Royal Bazaar of Mournhold.
Gaerthir is a Bosmer member of the Brackenleaf's Briars residing in the town of Brackenleaf.
Gandonion is a Bosmer residing in the Shrouded Vale, in the region of Greenshade.
Gananith is a Bosmer guild trader residing in the city of Ebonheart.
Gandilla Senim is a Dunmer residing in the city of Kragenmoor.
Galdas Indrano is a Dunmer chef and a member of the Mages Guild. She sells her wares inside the guild hall on Eyevea.
Gariasa Areleth is a Dunmer member of the Mages Guild. She is the magister of their branch in Tal'Deic Fortress.
Gaireth is a Bosmer member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Skywatch.
Garamiel Arrow-Catcher is a Bosmer outlaw residing in the Caravan Company Depot in Dragonstar.
Gamati al-Glessa is a Redguard residing in the city of Wayrest.
Garvas Othrys is a Dunmer residing in the Sulfur Pools. He was driven away from his farm when Daggerfall Covenant forces stormed the place.
Gashdug gro-Badbul is an Orsimer residing in the city of Sentinel.
Garrimar is a Nord bard residing in the city of Windhelm. She is one of the celebrants of the Konunleikar.
Galmar War-Wolf is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their guildhall in Windhelm.
Gareth is a Kothringi scout found east of Stillrise Village.
Gargum is an Orsimer found north of Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai.
Gah-Ju is an Argonian scholar and member of the Ebonheart Pact found reading books at Shadutsei's Emporium at the Southern Morrowind Gate in Cyrodiil.
Gahgdar is an Orsimer member of the Mages Guild in who was duped into giving a valuable book to a witch. He may be found at the Rubble Butte in Bangkorai.
Gahgra gra-Kruts is an Orsimer soldier residing in the city of Belkarth, Craglorn.
Gaillard Laussac is a Breton who was killed by the new member of the Fell's Run Town Guard.
Gakar is a male Nord in who resides at the Bal Foyen Dockyards.
Galam Seleth is a Dunmer guild trader. He operates his kiosk, Target Trades, in Dhalmora.
Galdsa Dres is a Dunmer priestess of House Dres. She is found inside the Tribunal Temple of Mournhold.
Galithor is a Bosmer brewmaster in who resides with his brother Alphrost in Vulkwasten.
Gallinius was an Imperial soldier part of Lyris Titanborn's team back when she was part of the Imperial Legion. He appears in The Foundry of Woe along with the other members of the group.

Galmon is a Dunmer ghost and brewer found in Sanguine's Demesne. There is a note in the dungeon that states that he found a loophole in a contract that he wrote, allowing him out of "a job that never ends."
Galori Thirano is a Dunmer soldier of House Hlaalu. She is found in the Obsidian Gorge.
Galriel is a Bosmer part of the Blacksap Rebellion found in Cormount.
Galsi Mavani is a Dunmer soldier of the Pact found at the Northern Morrowind Gate.
Galthonor is a Bosmer found in Rawl'kha. He can be found in The Outskirts of the city.
Gamirth is a deceased Nord in whose body can be found at The Everfull Flagon in Coldharbour.
Gamyne Bandu is a Dunmer assassin hired by the Spider Cult found in Fungal Grotto.
Ganariss is a Nord clothier found in Riften. He, along with Himarit and Adord escaped Northwind Mine after the Reachmen occupied it.
Ganrenan is a Bosmer who resides at the Thizzrini Arena, in Reaper's March.
Ganthis is a Dunmer soldier of the Pact. He is part of an expedition aiming to retrieve Argonian relics from the ruins of Bogmother.
Ganwen is a Bosmer in who is a patron at the Tall Trunk Tavern in Vulkwasten.
Gargak is an Orsimer member of the Barkbite Clan of Wood Orcs and leader of the Red Sun Bandits. He resides at the Barkbite Stronghold in Reman's Bluff, Grahtwood.
Garmath the Bold is a powerful Draugr warrior found in Direfrost Keep.

Garth is a Breton and best friend of Beryn. After the two of them got into a drinking contest, Beryn challenged Garth to enter the lair of Aesar the Hatespinner and collect the silk of one of its cocoons. Drunk as can be, he was captured and put into one himself.
Garvilda Coldheart is a Nord miner found at the Lost Knife Cave.
Garwiruin is a Bosmer residing in the city of Woodhearth, Greenshade.
Gasheg is an Orsimer guild trader who sells his wares at The Stormhold Exchange in the city of Stormhold, Shadowfen.
Gaspard the Hermit is a Breton hermit found praying outside the Crypt of Hearts.
Gasparien is a Breton member of the Supernal Dreamers found at Vaermina's Shrine in Cyrodiil.
Garil is a powerful Zombie found in the Forgotten Crypts. He is also the author of Garil's Journal.
Garlor is an Orsimer merchant and member of the Fighters Guild residing in the city of Orsinium. She can be found at the local guildhall selling her wares.
Garyne Rindu is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is stationed in Fort Virak.
Galotha Falas is a Dunmer mystic and a member of the Mages Guild residing in the city of Anvil, Gold Coast. She is found at the local branch, selling her wares.

Galrus Grimhorn is a friendly Minotaur who is the Retired Champion of the Hammerdeath Arena. He will usually be found at the northern platform, kneeling towards the edge while spectating the grounds, or walking across to view Landanta's stall.
Garaengrin is a Bosmer drunkard in who can be found in Deepwoods, Malabal Tor.
Galathril is a Bosmer archeologist. She is found with a team of researchers west of Willowgrove.
Galbor is a Bosmer beggar found near the docks of Vulkhel Guard.
Galam Arvel is a Dunmer laborer sweeping the floor outside the Temple Canton in Vivec City. He has no unique dialogue.
Galar Arobar is a Dunmer residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. He works in the Gnisis Egg Mine as an egg-hand. He has no unique dialogue.
Ganduin is a Dunmer blood matron of Lamae Bal. She was a living in Morrowind before she was attacked by one of Lamae's matrons. After that she served Lamae as a loyal child and Follower of her cult.
Galms Galen is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles found at the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Garridan Stalrous was a lord and knight of Cyrodiil. He was said to have been a fair and kind ruler.
Ganorith is a Bosmer commoner found in a garden in the southern part of Shimmerene, Summerset. She has no unique dialogue.

Ganus Bero is a Dunmer scholar found on the middle floor of Vinwysea's House in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. Since entering the house is considered trespassing, he may be hostile to the Vestige while inside. He has no unique dialogue.

Garikh is an Orsimer residing on the upper floor of the Anchors Aweigh Inn in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He can either be found reading in one of the rooms, or standing in front of the fireplace.
Galmelor is a Bosmer found in Kinlady Avinisse's Mansion in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset during the quest "The Queen's Decree."
Galulaben is an Altmer who can be found in the Academy Guest Wing in the Illumination Academy in Summerset. He cannot be interacted with.
Gaius Platorius is an Imperial envoy sent to the Town in to pay bounties for dealing with the large local goblin population.
Gashnakh gra-Mughol is an Orsimer foreman in charge of the construction of Tel Uvirith. She can be found in Uvirith's Grave.
Garen Bethalas is a Dunmeri arena combatant in the Imperial Arena.
Ganion is a character located in the Bone Orchard, Grahtwood, in .
Galsa-Baru is a Dunmer located in Mournhold, Deshaan, in . He was introduced as part of the prologue for .
Gellius Terentius is the son of ne'er-do-well Count of Bravil, Regulus Terentius. He, along with the other skooma addicts, can be found at the Skooma Den in Bravil every Sundas.

Gerdur is a Nord lumberjack residing in the town of Riverwood. She and her husband, Hod, own and operate Riverwood's lumber mill. They have a son, Frodnar. She is the de facto leader of the village and is the one who pays the taxes, though the land is owned by Jarl Balgruuf the Greater.

Gaturn gro-Gonk is an Orsimer living in Chorrol. He is a former Fighters Guild member who got thrown out for "Theft and Trespassing. Couple of times," but he doesn't remember how many times before they expelled him.
Geor Matreinace is a Breton Bard at the St. Veloth's Hostel in Molag Mar, Morrowind. Geor does not offer any services and is not involved in any quests.
Geel-Lah is an Argonian monk who lives in Ebonheart, Morrowind. He can be found in the Argonian Mission.
Gelephor is a Bosmer commoner who can be found guarding the Warehouse in the Imperial City, Market District. He occasionally travels to Bravil to drink Skooma at the Bravil Skooma Den.

Geel is an Argonian sharpshooter working at the Blackwood Company in Leyawiin. He doesn't have much to say, but he may have to be killed along with the rest of the Company during the last quest for the Fighters Guild. He does not offer any services. He stands by the Blackwood Company Hall Basement at all times.
General Tullius is a general of the Imperial Legion and military governor of Skyrim. He can be found inside Castle Dour, in Solitude. He wears a unique piece of armor and carries an Imperial Sword.
Gentleman Jim Stacey is the Redguard Guildmaster of the Thieves Guild in Vivec City. He can be found in the back of Simine Fralinie's shop, in the Vivec, Foreign Quarter Canalworks.
Gergio is an Imperial servant of the vampire Clan Berne, who resides in Galom Daeus with the rest of the clan.
Gerda is a Nord maid in Whiterun found sweeping the floors at Dragonsreach.
Gestur Rockbreaker is a Nord miner and resident of Stonehills, a small mining encampment. He works in the nearby Rockwallow Mine.
Gauldur was a powerful Breton conjurer and Arch-Mage of the College of Winterhold who lived during the First Era. He was all but erased from the annals of history by High King Harald.
Gelebros is a Bosmer sorcerer and member of the Psijic Order.
Gharol is an Orsimer blacksmith residing in the stronghold of Dushnikh Yal.
Gemma Uriel is an Imperial and the sister of Ganna Uriel located in Steamscorch Mine in Kynesgrove.
